brand_notes.materials: brands.json's brand-level fabric string ('X-Pac laminate / recycled-content waterproof sailcloth, HDPE skidplates, internal framesheets') matches what is visible across this catalogue. Every product shows the diamond-quilted X-Pac ripstop laminate (matte finish, faint diagonal quilt-stitch grid), taped/bar-tacked seams, and black webbing hardware in a consistent house style. The Sierra SL Pannier's lower front panel is a distinctly darker, slightly glossy heather-textured panel consistent with an HDPE skid plate. No mismatch found; the fabric string is accurate for this brand.
brand_notes.dimensionEvidence: Venture's product pages publish a 'true measured DIMENSIONS' string per product, almost always as a rolled-to-unfurled range for the roll axis plus one or two fixed cross-section figures. Per the new MODEL-SPEC rule, len/wid now take the UNFURLED (max) figure instead of the prior catalogue's rolled-down interpolated estimate, which changes len on the Bravo, Charlie, Delta, and Kilo records materially (previously computed as min + 0.3*range, now the plain unrolled maximum). Only the Sierra SL Pannier publishes its variable axis as a HEIGHT range (12-17in) rather than a length range, so it is the only product in this catalogue carrying a `render` block.
brand_notes.evidenceQuality: Two records are notably weaker than the rest. The EDC Mini Frame Bag's only local image (edc-edc-mini-frame-bag-large-large-1-4l-1.jpg) is a fabric colour-swatch card, not a photo of the product; its geometry/hardware fields are carried from catalogue text only and marked low confidence. The Alpha Custom Frame Bag is made-to-measure with no fixed size; only its 2.5in spine width is a real published number, so len/hgt are explicitly flagged as placeholders, not maker data, per the 'do not invent' rule.
brand_notes.closureCorrections: brands.json's features block lists 'zip' as the closure/pocket type for the Cache Tank Bag's main closure and for the Delta/Kilo handlebar bags' front accessory pocket. In every local photo of all three products, the visible closure is a diagonal flap held shut by a full-perimeter black hook-and-loop (velcro) strip — no zip pull or teeth are visible anywhere. It is plausible a welded zip sits hidden under the storm flap (a common construction on this style of pocket), so 'zip' is kept but confidence is lowered to medium and the mismatch is flagged on each record rather than silently resolved.
brand_notes.featureMismatch: The Alpha Custom Frame Bag's features block states 'cord': false, but the on-bike detail photo (alpha-alpha-custom-frame-bag-made-to-measure-2-16l-4.jpg) clearly shows a reflective bungee shock-cord criss-crossed through loop straps at the tail (seat-tube) end. This looks like a fit-cinching/lashing cord, not decoration. Flagged here since it directly contradicts the catalogue's own feature flag.

products.name: Bravo Seat Bag
products.dims_raw: true measured DIMENSIONS: 6.5"W x 12-16"L x 6.5"H; true measured VOLUME: 4.5-7L depending how far you roll it down
products.dims_note: Per the new MODEL-SPEC rule len takes the UNFURLED figure: 16in = 40.6cm (previously this catalogue used an interpolated packed estimate of 33.5cm). Width and height are both fixed at 6.5in = 16.5cm (no range published), consistent with the rounded tube seen in every photo, so no render block is needed — only length varies with roll count.

geometry.notes: Rounded tube, squared flat face at the saddle/seatpost end, moderate (not extreme) taper toward the rolled tail — the tail keeps meaningful diameter right up to the roll, unlike a sharply pointed wedge.

closure.hardware: single top strap with a red-accented side-release buckle clips down onto the velcro-covered rear cradle to compress and seal the roll

details.fabric: X-Pac laminate, diamond ripstop quilt pattern, matte

mount.notes: Nose clamps to the saddle rails/seatpost via a black velcro-covered cradle (Venture's 'RailWing V2' anti-sway hardware, not separately modelled as fabric); tail droops slightly and rolls to seal. clearance is an estimate based on typical bags of this size, not measured.

products.name: EDC Mini Frame Bag (Large)
evidence: assets/products/venture-handmade/edc-edc-mini-frame-bag-large-large-1-4l-1.jpg (fabric colour-swatch card only, NOT a photo of the product)
products.dims_raw: VOLUME: Large, 1.4L, true measured. DIMENSIONS: Large, 2.5"W, 10" top, 9.5" bottom, 2" front, 7.5" back
products.dims_note: No real product photo exists in the local set (the only local image is a fabric swatch card), so this entire record rests on the maker's text description alone. Venture quote four edge lengths rather than a box; read as a wedge the numbers are coherent (10in top, 9.5in bottom, 2in front, 7.5in back at 2.5in wide is about 1.9L of envelope against 1.4L rated, a normal margin for a wedge). Bounding box taken as len=10in=25.4cm (longest edge), hgt=7.5in=19.1cm (rear/tall edge), wid=2.5in=6.4cm (the one real width figure). Unchanged from the prior catalogue pass since no range/roll applies here — this is a fixed zip-closed wedge, not a rolltop.

geometry.notes: Steeply raked wedge per the maker's four-edge description: tall at the seat-tube end, tapering to almost nothing at the head-tube end — fills the rear corner of the front triangle rather than running its full length. Not photo-verified; geometry is inferred from the maker's edge-length text only.

closure.hardware: not photo-verified; carried from catalogue text ('closure: zip')

details.fabric: X-Pac laminate (assumed from brand consistency; the only local image is a fabric swatch card showing the full colour range, not applied to this specific bag)

mount.notes: Per maker copy: 'top tube and seat tube straps, front triangle apex'. Mounts in the rear corner of the front triangle near the seat tube/top tube junction, not spanning the full frame. Not photo-verified.

products.dims_note: Made to measure — no fixed size exists, so per the 'do not invent' rule len and hgt are carried as an unverified mid-range placeholder only (representative of an average full-triangle bag on the stated 2-16L range), NOT maker data. wid=6.4cm (2.5in) is the one real published number, the spine width. details.fabric: X-Pac laminate, diamond ripstop quilt pattern, matte

mount.notes: Flush-mounted full-triangle bag; nose squared off at the head tube, tapering to a criss-cross bungee-laced point near the seat tube/BB that likely allows some fit adjustment for different frame sizes. Custom/made-to-measure, so exact fit varies by order.

products.name: Sierra SL Pannier
products.dims_raw: DIMENSIONS: 10"W x 5"D x 12-17"H (each side). VOLUME: 20L for the pair (10L single). Weight 1lb 13oz/820g pair.
products.dims_note: PAIR VOLUME TRAP avoided: liters holds the single-bag 10L, not the 20L pair figure. Here the maker publishes the variable roll axis as HEIGHT (12-17in), not length, so per the new rule hgt takes the MINIMUM: 12in=30.5cm (previously an interpolated 34.3cm estimate). len=10in=25.4cm and wid=5in=12.7cm are both fixed footprint figures, unchanged. Volume check: 25.4x12.7x30.5=9840cc=9.8L against 10L stated single-bag capacity — a tight, box-like ratio consistent with a boxy pannier rather than a tapered wedge.

render.basis: On-bike and studio photos show a shallow double fold-over roll at the top secured by twin spring cord-locks plus a single horizontal compression strap — a boxy pannier, not a deep drybag roll, so only a modest height reduction from the 17in unfurled maximum is plausible. 30.5cm (the rule's minimum) reads correctly against the bag's other dimensions in the photos.

geometry.notes: Boxy pannier, flat rack-facing back panel, rounded rolltop corners at the top. Lower front face carries a distinct darker, faintly glossy heather-textured panel — the HDPE skid plate called out in the brand fabric string.

closure.hardware: two spring-loaded cord-locks at the top corners plus a single horizontal compression strap with a side-release buckle across the front face

details.fabric: X-Pac laminate body with a heather HDPE skid-plate panel on the lower front face, matte

mount.notes: Attaches to the rack rail via a strap-and-buckle system, not hooks, per maker copy ('strap-and-buckle to rack rails, no hooks'), visible in the on-bike photo as a black strap wrapping the top rail. Sold and shipped as a pair. tyre_mm clearance from the rear wheel is an estimate, not measured.
